feature_representation.actual_implementation: Direct extraction of structured clinical key-value pairs from clinical_data.json
feature_representation.discrepancy: None. Tabular clinical features are directly parsed into numeric and categorical feature matrices.

modality_fusion.discrepancy: PIPELINE_COMPONENT_DORMANT. The benchmark task is unimodal tabular clinical data; cross-attention is bypassed in code.
modality_fusion.scientific_consequence: The empirical HANCOCK experiment does not validate cross-attention. Must be labeled as EVIDENCE_BACKED_BUT_DORMANT.

ensembling.discrepancy: PIPELINE_COMPONENT_DORMANT. Execution fits a single regularized XGBoost model without model ensembling.
ensembling.scientific_consequence: The empirical HANCOCK experiment does not evaluate model ensembling. Must be labeled as EVIDENCE_BACKED_BUT_DORMANT.

missing_value_handling.discrepancy: PIPELINE_IMPLEMENTATION_MISMATCH. Configured as multivariate MICE/MissForest, but code executes univariate median/mode imputation.
missing_value_handling.scientific_consequence: The reported results reflect univariate median/mode imputation, not iterative multivariate MICE. Manuscript must be reconciled.

base_learner.discrepancy: None. XGBClassifier is directly instantiated and fitted.
base_learner.scientific_consequence: Valid execution of regularized gradient tree boosting base learner.

imbalance_handling.discrepancy: None. SMOTE is fitted strictly on the training partition.
imbalance_handling.scientific_consequence: Valid execution of class imbalance handling.

categorical_encoding.discrepancy: None. Fitted strictly on training categorical data.
